spans.s:
. Straight metaphorically, as in
morals, upright, honest.
 E. ऋज् to go, affix कु.

ऋजुकाय m. (-यः) A name of the saint KAŚYAPA.
 E. ऋजु straight, काय body.

ऋजुता f. (-ता)
 1. Uprightness, sincerity.
 2. Straightness.
 E. ऋजु with तल्
affix; also with त्व, ऋजुत्वं.

ऋजूकरण n. (-णं) Straightening.
 E. ऋजु and करण making; the vowel
lengthened.

ऋजूकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made straight.
 E. ऋजु and कृत made; the vowel
lengthened.
